title: Prospective predictions: functional sign classes in Indus seal inscriptions
author: Parag Garg

class_induction.PRE-TERMINAL: residual & n>=10 & continuations>=8 & P(next in TERMINAL)>=0.60

rules.R1: TERMINAL tokens only in terminal zone (final position, or immediately preceding a TERMINAL token in final position)
rules.R4: non-final PRE-TERMINAL immediately followed by TERMINAL

P1.statement: modal ending sign takes 28-45% of endings and satisfies TERMINAL threshold

P3.statement: zero-violation compliance (terminal-zone R1) 65-82% and >=25 points above within-text shuffle; report applicability and conditional accuracy

P4.statement: pre-enumerated stroke taxonomy contains >=1 family: >=3 members, monotone frequencies, final-rate<5%

P5.statement: double-terminal endings (distinct signs) 4-18% of eligible texts

P7.statement: final-position entropy (Miller-Madow, min count 30) lower than initial by >=0.3 bits

P8.statement: foreign texts: elevated mean per-text surprisal under home model; effect size primary; no significance for n<10

P9.statement: emblem-animal vs terminal-distribution weighted JSD < 0.10 bits (bias-corrected bootstrap CI below delta)

falsification: P3 failure falsifies the induced structure; P1-P2 failure falsifies generality of terminal organisation
